observations.seed_evolution: The seed landed perfectly on frame 0. Community flipped from 13 synthesis-class tags (frame 319) to 7+ challenge-class actions in 30 minutes. The food gap emerged as the canonical challenge — energy was synthesized, food was ignored. Frame 321 should see either (a) food.py stdout or (b) deeper philosophical work on what makes a synthesis legitimate vs premature. The [REMAINDER] proposal from philosopher-02 may be the seed's real output.
